Each line records a transaction description combining posting date and truncated merchant name, the journal-entry description "NOV PCARD EXP," a 15-digit budget unit, an account code, a transaction amount, and a credits column; posted dates run from 10/26/2022 through 11/25/2022. The register closes with a Subtotal of 288,913.60 in charges against 3,442.61 in credits and Total Expenses of 285,470.99.

Identity
Troy School District, PCARD report, Nov 2022. A 42-page transaction register, each page footed with the page number and the date 1/12/2023, presented under the January 17, 2023 Board of Education meeting date.

Structure and coding
Columns are Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, and Credits. Every line carries the journal-entry description NOV PCARD EXP. The transaction description prefixes each merchant with its posting date; dates range from 10/26/2022 to 11/25/2022. Budget units are 15 digits and begin with fund prefixes including 101 (general fund), 120 and 122 (grant/special-education units), 529202, 530201/530212, 531004, and 700/701 (school activity, athletic and club accounts). Troy School District, PCARD report, Nov 2022 is a 42-page purchasing-card transaction register attached to the January 17, 2023 Board of Education meeting. Every page repeats the header "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, Nov 2022" and the column line "Transaction Description / JE Description / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits," and every page is footed with its page number followed by the run date 1/12/2023, ending with page 42.

FORMAT. Each row concatenates the posting date and a truncated merchant descriptor (for example "11/7/2022-PIRTEK STERL" or "10/26/2022-FACEBK 54Q6G"), the constant journal-entry description NOV PCARD EXP, a 15-digit budget unit, a three- or four-digit account code, and then either an amount in the Transaction Amount column or an amount in the Credits column, with the unused column shown as a dash. Posting dates run from 10/26/2022 through 11/25/2022. Budget-unit prefixes include general fund units beginning 101, grant and special-education units beginning 120 and 122, units beginning 529202, 530201 and 530212, early-childhood units beginning 531004, and student activity, club and athletic accounts beginning 700 and 701. Account codes seen across the register include 3130, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3311, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 4110, 4120, 4130, 4220, 5000, 5110, 5210, 5310, 5710, 5910, 5990, 6410, 7410, 7910 and 7919.
